description: The alkali resonance doublets' far wings beyond the atoms' 25 cm-1 shape as pair cross-sections, m5 a pair, on vacuum wavelengths (rendering plan R08, R08.T4.e; follow-up 5, ruling 2), written by apps/hyperion/scripts/atmosphereData.mjs alkali-pairs from the fetched files named here, which are not committed: Na D's with H2 from Allard et al. 2019's open tables, and Na D's with He and K's with H2 and He as the ruled estimate. Each row is [nm, sigma at each temperature]. Reduced values; the citations are in NOTICE's Data section.

pairs.source: N. F. Allard, F. Spiegelman, T. Leininger and P. Molliere, New study of the line profiles of sodium perturbed by H2, Astron. Astrophys. 628 (2019) A120, DOI 10.1051/0004-6361/201935593 (CDS J/A+A/628/A120, opacity.tar.gz, tables 2017); the doublet's gf and vacuum wavenumbers from R. L. Kurucz's gf1100.all (R. L. Kurucz, "Including all the lines", Can. J. Phys. 89 (2011) 417, DOI 10.1139/p10-104); its lower level's share by Barklem and Collet 2016's partition functions (Astron. Astrophys. 588 (2016) A96, CDS J/A+A/588/A96 table 8)

pairs.terms: Allard et al.'s tables are CDS's (J/A+A/628/A120; VizieR's data free of usage in a scientific context, A&A-origin tables free for a scientific usage, read 2026-10-19; the deposit's README states none); Kurucz states no terms: reduced values with their citations, the raw files not committed and the deposit's readers not run (decision-r08-licences.md)
pairs.reduction: Allard et al.'s one-perturber wing: each table's first-order expansion coefficient c1 (their section 3.3, Eq. 15) at n_ref = 1e21 cm-3, the normalised profile per H2 c1 / n_ref, times the line's strength per Na atom S, linear in c1 between the tables' detunings and 0 where c1 falls below 0 (D2's blue edge); D1's red wing beyond its near-wing table from its redwing file, sigma at 1e21 cm-3 linear in density by the deposit's README, ln sigma linear between its points; D1's blue wing beyond its near-wing table, not deposited, left out (2-5% of D2's blue wing at 200-2000 cm-1 by its impact estimate); 0 beyond the tables' detunings. Measured over the tables' 500-3000 K. Each 1 nm vacuum cell, [nm - 0.5, nm + 0.5), of 380-800 nm takes the mean over 2000 equal steps of wavelength of D2's and D1's wings at points more than 25 cm-1 from each line's centre, where the atom's own k-distribution table holds the line (R08.T4.e), converted from cm5 to m5, linear in T between the temperatures and held beyond them (estimated).

pairs.reduction: A stated estimate (decision-r08-t4ef-storage section 6, ruling 6; no open Na-He set found at fetch): R08.T4.c's impact (Lorentz) far wing, linear in the perturber's density, per pair S gamma_p / (pi Delta^2), with S the line's strength per Na atom and gamma_p its half width per He as the atom's table takes it (Allard et al. 2019's ab initio impact width by H2 scaled by Unsold's polarisability rule), so that the wing meets the core at 25 cm-1; estimated at every temperature and wavelength (estimatedBelowNm past the grid), since past about 50 cm-1 the wing is quasi-static, not impact, and may lie a few times above or below it (Na-H2's open tables run 2-12 times their impact estimate in D2's blue wing at 200-2000 cm-1). Each 1 nm vacuum cell, [nm - 0.5, nm + 0.5), of 380-800 nm takes the mean over 2000 equal steps of wavelength of D2's and D1's wings at points more than 25 cm-1 from each line's centre, where the atom's own k-distribution table holds the line (R08.T4.e), converted from cm5 to m5, linear in T between the temperatures and held beyond them (estimated).
